newsitem.title: USA: Dow index drops 120 points in heavy trading.
newsitem.headline: Dow index drops 120 points in heavy trading.

text.p: The Dow Jones industrial average raced lower as investors nailed down profits Wednesday after the blue-chip index failed for the second straight day to punch through the 8,000-point mark.
Based on early and unofficial data, the Dow ended down 119.88 points, or 1.51 percent, at 7,842.43. An early rally stalled at 7,991.26.
In the broader market, declining issues led advances 17-11 on heavy volume of 593 million shares on the New York Stock Exchange.
